# GiftPicker

> GiftPicker (giftpicker.io) is a free 60-second gift finder quiz by Presently. Users answer five questions about the recipient (relationship and age, occasion, interests, vibe, budget) and receive ranked, personalized gift picks from a hand-curated catalog of more than 500 gifts from 600+ brands, with direct buy links to the brand's site or Amazon. No account required.

## What it does

- Five-question quiz: who the gift is for (partner, parent, grandparent, friend, sibling, coworker, mentor, or treat yourself) and their age (6 tiers: baby, little one, teenager, young adult, adult, senior), the occasion (11 options, see below), up to 3 interests, up to 2 vibes (skipped for Sympathy), and a budget slider.
- Occasions covered: Birthday, Anniversary, Holiday, Wedding, Just Because, New Baby, Housewarming, Appreciation, Thank You, New Job, Sympathy (only gifts hand-picked for someone grieving), or Other, which reveals a free-text field for a custom occasion.
- Interest categories: Apparel and Accessories, Books and Reading, Cooking, Creativity, Experiences, Fitness, Food and Drinks, Gaming, Gardening and Plants, Health and Wellness, Home and Decor, Learning, Music, Nature and Outdoors, Organization, Personalization, Pets, Rest and Relaxation, Seasonal Gifts, Self-Care and Beauty, Sports, Sustainability, Tech and Electronics, Toys and Games, Travel.
- Vibes: Fun, Practical, Sentimental, Luxurious.
- Every gift in the catalog is hand-curated by the GiftPicker team, then matched to the quiz answers by a weighted scoring algorithm (interests weighted heaviest, then relationship, then budget fit, age fit, and vibe, with occasion adjustments). Only strong matches are shown, scored 0-100.
- Results pages can be shared via URL; the link reproduces the same picks.
- Gifts are hand-curated from 600+ brands including Apple, Lululemon, Patagonia, Pottery Barn, Anthropologie, Peloton, Aesop, Le Creuset, Diptyque, Le Labo, Smeg, and Bose.

## Gift pages

Every gift has a permanent, indexable page at https://giftpicker.io/gift/{id} (more than 500 live pages, listed in the sitemap). Each page contains the gift's name and brand, a description, its price or price range, a product photo, a direct buy link (to the brand's site or Amazon, tagged as an affiliate link where applicable), and schema.org Product structured data (name, description, image, brand, and price where available).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://giftpicker.io/): product overview and quiz entry point.
- [Quiz](https://giftpicker.io/quiz): the five-question gift finder quiz.
- [For brands](https://giftpicker.io/brands): how brands submit a product for free editorial review or request a sponsored placement. Sponsored gifts pass the same review, only appear in results they match, and are always labeled.
- [Gift guides](https://giftpicker.io/blog): the GiftPicker blog, practical gift guides that link to the gifts they recommend.
- [Sitemap](https://giftpicker.io/sitemap.xml): every indexable page, meaning the home page, the blog and each post, and every live gift page.

## Gift guides

Each guide is a full article with sections, plain-text ideas, and links to the gift pages it recommends, plus BlogPosting, BreadcrumbList, and ItemList structured data.

- [How to choose a gift by love language](https://giftpicker.io/blog/how-to-choose-a-gift-by-love-language): Learn the everyday clues that show which love language someone speaks, then find gift ideas for quality time, words, acts of service, touch, and gifts.
- [Just-because gifts for your partner](https://giftpicker.io/blog/just-because-gifts-for-your-partner): Surprise gifts for your partner for no reason at all: ideas for a night in, a night out, a little pampering, sentimental keepsakes, and small treats.
- [Gifts for Mom and Dad, from morning coffee to lights out](https://giftpicker.io/blog/gifts-for-mom-and-dad-from-morning-to-night): A short list of gifts for Mom and Dad: a better morning coffee, dinners with a night off, weekend trips, a way to stay close, and a family video montage.
- [Gifts for your brother or sister, from game night to their first apartment](https://giftpicker.io/blog/gifts-for-your-brother-or-sister): Gift ideas for every kind of sibling, from the game night champion to the one who just moved into their first place, plus a few ideas that cost nothing.
- [How much to spend on a coworker gift, with picks at every price](https://giftpicker.io/blog/how-much-to-spend-on-a-coworker-gift): Budget guidance for coworker gifts from you or the whole team, with picks for birthdays, promotions, weddings, new babies, farewells, and hard times.
- [What to send someone who is sick, recovering, or grieving](https://giftpicker.io/blog/what-to-send-someone-who-is-sick-or-grieving): Thoughtful, low-pressure gifts for a friend, relative, or colleague who is ill, recovering, or grieving a person or a pet, plus free ways to help.
- [Gifts for the man who says he doesn't need anything](https://giftpicker.io/blog/gifts-for-men-who-say-they-dont-need-anything): Four ways to shop for a man who already owns what he needs: an experience, an everyday upgrade, something he'll use up, or a new hobby.

Note: /results pages are per-visitor quiz output and are not meant to be indexed or cited as a canonical source. Use the gift pages above instead.

## About

GiftPicker is built and curated by Presently. The catalog is maintained by hand, and every gift is a real product from a real brand. Feedback tools are built in (users can flag broken links, unavailable products, or bad matches, and request new gift categories).
